# PGSathi - Verified PGs & PG Management Software

PGSathi is India's leading platform for finding Paying Guest (PG) accommodations, hostels, and rooms for rent, as well as providing powerful PG Management Software for owners. 

## For Tenants
- Search for 100% verified Boys, Girls, and Co-ed PGs across India.
- Zero brokerage and direct contact with PG owners.
- Verified photos, amenities, and location details.

## For PG Owners & Managers
- Free property listing.
- Direct tenant leads via WhatsApp.
- Powerful dashboard to manage rent, tenants, inventory, and complaints.
- Zero commission on leads.

## Key Features
- Geo-location based PG search.
- Advanced filtering by budget, sharing type, and amenities.
- CRM for PG owners with analytics and automated rent reminders.
- Partner program for affiliates to earn by onboarding PGs.

Website: https://pgsathi.in
Contact: pgsathi.support@gmail.com
